answer: Persistent operator liability links every identity to a verified operator through a shared reputation ledger. Like a comet whose tail always points home, each wallet's actions debit the operator's collateral and future eligibility, so a sybil cluster exposes one party to multiplied loss. When suspicious accounts trip a lantern threshold, the operator's entire account is frozen pending audit. Any verified human signal can be farmed, but an operator pays the full penalty per fake identity, making mass fabrication economically unviable.
